title: Vietnamese Beef Stew
description: A twist on the classic beef stew, this Vietnamese version is flavorful and aromatic. The beef is slow-cooked in a rich and savory broth, making it tender and juicy.

instructions.step: In a large Dutch oven, heat 2 tablespoons of oil over medium-high heat. Add the beef and cook until browned, about 5 minutes. Remove the beef from the pot and set it aside.
Add the onion and garlic to the pot and cook until the onion is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the carrots and potatoes to the pot and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the beef broth, fish sauce, soy sauce, sugar, and black pepper to the pot. Stir to combine.
Return the beef to the pot and bring the mixture to a boil.
Cover the pot with a lid and transfer it to the preheated oven. Cook for 2 1/2 hours, or until the beef is tender and the vegetables are cooked through.
Remove the pot from the oven and let it cool slightly.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
